scripts._dev: concurrently -n web,convex,runtime "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:convex" "bun run dev:runtime"
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:runtime && bun run build:desktop
scripts.test: vitest run && bun run --filter './apps/runtime' test && bun run --filter './apps/desktop' test
scripts.test:unit: vitest run && bun run --filter './apps/runtime' test && bun run --filter './apps/desktop' test
scripts.test:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:core:raw && PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:perf:raw && PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:external:raw
scripts.test:e2e:core:raw: bunx playwright test --project chromium-core && PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 bunx playwright test --project chromium-auth
scripts.test:all: vitest run && PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:core:raw && PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:external:raw && PLAYWRIGHT_ENV_FILE=.env.local bun --env-file=.env.local run test:e2e:perf:raw
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter './components/domain' typecheck && bun run --filter './apps/web' typecheck && bun run --filter './apps/runtime' typecheck && bun run --filter './apps/desktop' typecheck && bun run typecheck:convex && bun run typecheck:e2e
